summary: Round 1's F1 is resolved: the four ScanToPdf and MyDownloads carriers are now in P12a–b behind the prd health gate, with no batch pinning a deploy repo twice. Their downstream triggers, the auto-sync and the durations were re-verified against Jenkins, GitHub and Argo CD. The Ansible diff is unchanged and correct. One advisory finding: close-out N4 says scantopdf-prd and media-prd restart once, but two carriers pin each of them.

findings.summary: Close-out N4 says scantopdf-prd and media-prd restart once during P12a–b; two carriers per deploy repo, in separate batches, make each restart twice.
